summary: Texas Ventures Acquisition IV Corp filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) of 17,250,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option, generating $172.5 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The filing details the entry into standard IPO agreements: underwriting, warrant, and trust agreements. This is a routine IPO closing event for a blank-check company, not a special-situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation has been announced; the SPAC has yet to identify a target.
